lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.15 - A Listen and say. Then practise.

details: Listen and Say checks understanding of word meaning and pronunciation of the phrases shown, then practise.
Look for careful listening, clear pronunciation of words and phrases, correct intonation and use of the visual and written prompts provided.
“This party will be fun! Look! Someone is blowing up balloons and someone else is setting the table…if we listen carefully, we can find out who is doing what job. Thank you for your help!”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.15 - B. Ask and answer

details: Ask and Answer gives students controlled practice using the target language to ask and respond to simple questions.
Look for accurate and clear answers, correct pronunciation and word stress, consistent references to the pictures given.
“What a lot of activities. We have Sam, Tom, Anne, Kate, Dave and Judy but who is doing what? I can’t keep track. Can you match the pictures to the names? Let’s practise together!”

Heads Down:

details:
Homework Check:
Have Ss open to the previous lesson’s homework. Score completion %. Conduct activity feedback and error correction. Score achievement %. 
Project Gallery:

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p.71 - A Look and write.

details: Look and write gives students the chance to test their ability to write a word correctly using written clues and images. It checks their understanding of an image as they pair it with the correct description.
Look for good comprehension of the phrases in the word box, accurate pairing with the correct image, neat handwriting,
“Let’s be party detectives! Look carefully at each picture and choose the right phrase to go under each picture. Check your spellings carefully to become a top detective.”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p.71 - B Match and write.

details: Match and write checks whether the students can match the two parts of each sentence, checking comprehension and written skills.
Look for accurate answers and correct, complete sentences, correct identification of which sentences match the images and accurate handwriting.

Heads Up:

Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

Homework Set:
Complete an example of the homework to check Ss understanding. Have Ss then write the homework page, activity and plan in their diaries. 
Leaderboard:
Show the Leaderboard and congratulate / encourage daily app practise.

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.16 - Speaking Some information is missing from the party checklist! Ask for it and write the names

details: Missing information gives pupils a chance to review what they have learnt against the information they’ve been given.
Look for confident use of language, correctly formed questions, accurate listening and responses.

“Oh no! Our party checklist isn’t finished! Some names are missing, and I can’t remember who is doing what. Can you ask your classmates to help me complete it before the party starts?” [hold up example checklist]

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down (closed pairs): 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together (open pairs): 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.16 - Complete the email from Rosa

details: Complete the email allows students to apply target structures in a written context. It reinforces recall and written accuracy.
Look for logical answers that fit the context, appropriate vocabulary, accurate spelling.
“Rosa didn’t finish her email about the party! Let’s help her complete the message so she can send it to her friends. Can you work out what her friends are doing for the party?”

Heads Up (Reading): 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and help Ss to understand the text by asking questions, practicing skimming (reading for gist), scanning (reading for specific information) and detail (reading for comprehension). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down (Listen and Sing): 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together (Video Song): 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs
